messages.thumb_curl_more: Bend your thumb in slightly closer to your palm.
messages.thumb_extend_more: Straighten your thumb out a bit more.
messages.index_curl_more: Curl your index finger down toward your palm.
messages.index_extend_more: Straighten your index finger all the way up.
messages.middle_curl_more: Curl your middle finger down toward your palm.
messages.middle_extend_more: Straighten your middle finger all the way up.
messages.ring_curl_more: Curl your ring finger down into your palm.
messages.ring_extend_more: Straighten your ring finger up more.
messages.pinky_curl_more: Curl your pinky finger down into your palm.
messages.pinky_extend_more: Straighten your pinky finger up more.
messages.thumb_index_apart: Move your thumb and index fingertip slightly farther apart.
messages.thumb_index_closer: Bring your thumb and index fingertip closer together.
messages.thumb_middle_apart: Move your thumb away from your middle fingertip.
messages.thumb_middle_closer: Bring your thumb closer to your middle fingertip.
messages.thumb_ring_apart: Move your thumb away from your ring finger.
messages.thumb_ring_closer: Bring your thumb closer to your ring finger.
messages.thumb_pinky_apart: Move your thumb away from your pinky finger.
messages.thumb_pinky_closer: Bring your thumb closer to your pinky finger.
messages.index_middle_apart: Spread your index and middle fingers slightly apart.
messages.index_middle_closer: Bring your index and middle fingers together so they touch.
messages.index_ring_apart: Spread your index and ring fingers slightly apart.
messages.index_ring_closer: Bring your index and ring fingers closer together.
messages.index_pinky_apart: Spread your index and pinky fingers wider.
messages.index_pinky_closer: Bring your index and pinky fingers closer together.
messages.middle_ring_apart: Spread your middle and ring fingers slightly apart.
messages.middle_ring_closer: Bring your middle and ring fingers closer together.
messages.middle_pinky_apart: Spread your middle and pinky fingers slightly apart.
messages.middle_pinky_closer: Bring your middle and pinky fingers closer together.
messages.ring_pinky_apart: Spread your ring and pinky fingers slightly apart.
messages.ring_pinky_closer: Bring your ring and pinky fingers closer together.
messages.wrist_tilt_right: Tilt your hand slightly to the right.
messages.wrist_tilt_left: Tilt your hand slightly to the left.
messages.palm_face_camera: Turn your palm more directly toward the camera.
messages.palm_turn_away: Angle your palm slightly away from the camera.

unableReasons.no_hand_detected: No hand detected — raise one hand into the frame.
unableReasons.sign_not_in_pack: This sign is not configured in the active language pack.
unableReasons.low_detection_confidence: Hand tracking confidence is low — improve lighting or hold steady.
unableReasons.hand_too_far: Hand is too far — move closer to the camera.
unableReasons.hand_too_close: Hand is too close — move slightly back from the camera.
unableReasons.hand_out_of_frame: Keep your entire hand inside the camera frame.
unableReasons.turn_palm_toward_camera: Turn your palm toward the camera so all fingers are visible.
unableReasons.hand_moving_too_fast: Hold your hand steady for evaluation.
